notes.title: Our latest game "My Lovely Wife" is coming tomorrow!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26669058/3592385ffd458a171ede040b36bfab3fa96808de.jpg[/img]

[h3]My Lovely Wife, The spin-off sequel to our dark narrative management game My Lovely Daughter, is going to be released tomorrow on [u][b]June 8![/b][/u][/h3]

[previewyoutube=HF2zakfIaJc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Build Revert
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28003403/a8e4312f635e271f539f76015d5eda339275a304.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28003403/246fc9f7f1a5c3cd5a03dbaf6e999ed499ba922b.png[/img][/url]

Reverting the build to fix the achievement issues. The build contains one issue where one of the endings can not be triggered.

The introduction of the Ending_Fix branch in the Beta. Use this build branch to get the ending where you need to [spoiler]pray 30 times consecutively at the Giant Tree on Everest[/spoiler]. After saving, re-download the default branch and trigger the achievement.

notes.title: Our latest game "My Lovely Daughter" is now on Switch
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31818974/0700566eaf4824a336376d8562414aa9670ac191.png[/img]

Hello, Ascenderians!

As you probably know, last year we released [b]My Lovely Daughter[/b] on steam. And now we gladly announced that [b]My Lovely Daughter[/b] is now available on Nintendo Switch eShop! We are excited as this is our first game on a video game console.

You can purchase the game now with 33% discount until May 30, 2019.

[b]NA[/b] [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/my-lovely-daughter-switch]bit.ly/mldswitch[/url]
[b]EU[/b] [url=https://www.nintendo.co.uk/-1560677.html]bit.ly/mldswitcheu[/url]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SkLX1JE1QlM

That's all from us, have a lovely day.

Regards,

Amethyst

notes.title: Check out our ongoing project "My Lovely Daughter"
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26669058/b8be48d9429e962cf0abbc7f4c49d238de560366.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

As some of you know, we are currently developing another game titled, My Lovely Daughter. It is an alchemist simulator game that explores the depth of a father’s grief and how he will go to resurrect his daughter. 

We have been working on finishing the game for more than a year. Currently, we are working on wrapping up the game and preparing it for release.

As for now you can check out the game steam page and make sure put it on your wishlist if you like it.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/580170/My_Lovely_Daughter/

Regards,


Amethyst
